name: e_RP_250
summary: This EA implements a trend-following strategy based on the RP (Relative Price) indicator with a 250-period lookback, identifying trend direction and entering positions when price momentum aligns with the prevailing trend. It uses fixed lot sizing with stop loss and take profit levels, applying the RP indicator to determine entry and exit signals systematically without manual intervention.
summary_zh: 该EA基于RP（相对价格）指标实现趋势跟踪策略，使用250周期回溯期识别趋势方向，当价格动量与主导趋势一致时入场。采用固定手数并设置止损止盈，通过RP指标系统化地确定入场和出场信号，无需人工干预。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是利用250周期的RP（相对价格）指标来判断市场趋势方向，当RP指标显示上升趋势时做多，显示下降趋势时做空。入场条件依赖RP指标穿越其信号线或突破关键阈值，确认趋势成立后才开仓。出场条件包括预设的止损和止盈水平，以及RP指标发出趋势反转信号时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未根据账户余额或风险比例动态调整。资金管理方面相对简单，没有使用复杂的资金管理算法或风险比例计算，止损止盈的比例设置需要用户根据市场特性自行优化。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA relies on the 250-period RP (Relative Price) indicator to determine market trend direction, going long when RP indicates an uptrend and short when it indicates a downtrend. Entry conditions depend on the RP indicator crossing its signal line or breaking through key thresholds, confirming trend establishment before opening positions. Exit conditions include preset stop loss and take profit levels, as well as closing positions when the RP indicator issues a trend reversal signal. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account balance or risk proportion. Money management is relatively simple, lacking complex money management algorithms or risk-proportion calculations, and the stop-loss/take-profit ratio settings require user optimization based on market characteristics.

parameters.name: RP_Period
parameters.description: RP指标计算周期，用于确定趋势回溯长度
parameters.description_en: RP indicator period, determines trend lookback length

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，限制单笔交易最大亏损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, limits max loss per trade

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，锁定单笔交易利润目标
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, locks profit target per trade

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA唯一标识号，用于区分不同EA的订单
parameters.description_en: Magic number for closing, 0 for all positions

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于趋势跟踪原理，顺势交易胜率相对较高
使用250周期长周期参数，能有效过滤短期市场噪音和假突破
设有止损止盈，单笔交易风险可控，不会出现无限亏损的情况
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on trend-following principles, with relatively higher win rate when trading with the trend
Uses a long 250-period lookback that effectively filters short-term market noise and false breakouts
Has stop loss and take profit settings, making single-trade risk controllable without unlimited loss exposure
cons: 固定手数不考虑账户规模变化，大账户可能风险不足，小账户可能风险过大
250周期参数在震荡行情中可能产生频繁的假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏动态止损和移动止损机制，无法在趋势延续时锁定更多利润
cons_en: Fixed lot size does not account for account size changes, potentially under-risking large accounts or over-risking small ones
The 250-period parameter may generate frequent false signals during ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
Lacks dynamic stop loss and trailing stop mechanisms, unable to lock in more profit during trend continuation
improvements: 引入动态仓位管理，根据账户余额和风险比例自动调整手数
增加市场状态过滤器，在震荡行情中暂停交易以避免假信号亏损
添加移动止损功能，在趋势延续时逐步锁定利润并减少回撤
improvements_en: Introduce dynamic position sizing that automatically adjusts lot size based on account balance and risk ratio
Add a market state filter to pause trading during ranging markets to avoid losses from false signals
Implement trailing stop functionality to progressively lock in profits and reduce drawdown during trend continuation

risk_points: 固定手数未根据账户资金动态调整，可能导致风险敞口不合理
长周期指标在趋势转折点反应迟缓，可能造成较大浮亏后才触发止损
未检测是否存在同向持仓重复开仓，可能叠加风险敞口
risk_points_en: Fixed lot size without dynamic adjustment based on account equity may lead to unreasonable risk exposure
Long-period indicator reacts slowly at trend turning points, potentially causing significant floating loss before stop loss triggers
No check for existing positions in the same direction, which may stack risk exposure with duplicate entries

summary_en: This EA implements a trend-following strategy based on the RP (Relative Price) indicator with a 250-period lookback, identifying trend direction and entering positions when price momentum aligns with the prevailing trend. It uses fixed lot sizing with stop loss and take profit levels, applying the RP indicator to determine entry and exit signals systematically without manual intervention.
